why: This is a named, domain-specific self-report assessment instrument for measuring six motivational and epistemological constructs, not a reusable instructional element.
name: 29-item motivational survey for introductory physics students
product_description: A written 29-item Likert-scale survey adapted by Marshman et al. to measure introductory physics students’ fascination, value, self-efficacy, intelligence mindset, grit, and physics epistemology.
